movies.title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
movies.description: A sorcerer supreme is forced to journey across terrifying alternate realities to confront a mysterious new threat, guided by an old friend and a young woman with a rare gift.

movies.title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
movies.description: Having taken control of the Kolar Gold Fields, a fearless miner must now defend his empire from a ruthless new enemy and the full weight of the government closing in.

movies.title: RRR
movies.description: Set in the 1920s, two real-life revolutionaries fight British colonial rule, their unlikely friendship forming the heart of an epic tale of courage and sacrifice.

movies.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
movies.description: When a spell to restore his secret identity goes wrong, Peter Parker must face villains from other worlds who suddenly know exactly who he is.

movies.title: Pathaan
movies.description: A disavowed spy is pulled back into action to stop a rogue former agent from unleashing a catastrophic attack on the country he once served.

movies.title: Jawan
movies.description: A man moonlighting as a vigilante takes on the corrupt and powerful, driven by a debt from his past and a promise to protect the ones society forgot.

movies.title: Animal
movies.description: A son's obsessive devotion to his father spirals into a violent reckoning as old rivalries resurface and blood ties are tested to their limit.

movies.title: 12th Fail
movies.description: Based on real events, a young man from a small town fails again and again on his path to becoming a civil servant, refusing to let failure define him.

movies.title: Kalki 2898 AD
movies.description: In a decaying future where hope has all but vanished, a mythical prophecy stirs, and a reluctant bounty hunter finds himself at the center of a war for humanity's survival.

movies.title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
movies.description: A red sandalwood smuggler tightens his grip over the syndicate, but growing power invites even bigger enemies determined to see his empire fall.

movies.title: Alpha
movies.description: Two elite spies are pulled into a deadly, high-stakes mission that tests their loyalty, skill, and survival instincts against a ruthless enemy network.

movies.title: Dhamaal 4
movies.description: A hilarious new treasure hunt sends a chaotic gang of misfits chasing a hidden fortune, leading to non-stop laughs, twists, and mayhem.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.description: A young man's dangerous wish sets off a chilling chain of events, drawing him into a night of obsession, dread, and deadly consequences.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.description: A young warrior prince must master the power of Grayskull and rally allies across a mystical world to defend Eternia from a tyrannical sorcerer.

movies.title: The Odyssey
movies.description: A legendary warrior's perilous journey home after a long war unfolds across mythic seas, monstrous trials, and the pull of fate itself, shot entirely on IMAX film cameras.

movies.title: Main Vaapas Aaunga
movies.description: A heartfelt tale of love, longing, and a promise to return, set against the fields and quiet villages of Punjab.

movies.title: Disclosure Day
movies.description: When an unprecedented global event forces humanity to confront the truth about what's out there, a small group of witnesses race to understand what's really unfolding before the world changes forever.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: With his identity and life turned upside down, Peter Parker must find his footing again as new threats emerge across the city, and a fresh chapter of his story begins.
